brief:
Implement `CardVertical`, a course card for the UpSkill design system, exported from CardVertical/index.tsx. Build it to this approved API proposal: a preset (`<CardVertical …props />`) plus parts. Attach the parts to the preset as statics (`CardVertical.Root`, `CardVertical.Media`, …) and build the preset from them. Export a props type for the preset (`CardVerticalProps`), one for every part that takes props (`CardVertical<Part>Props`, e.g. `CardVerticalFavoriteProps`), and `CardVerticalSize`.

Anatomy (top to bottom, nesting shown by indentation):
- Root
  - Media: the thumbnail image
    - Action: optional overlay in the image's top-right corner, holding exactly one Favorite or Menu
      - Favorite: a heart toggle button
      - Menu: a kebab button that opens a dropdown menu
  - Progress: a progress bar
  - Body
    - Title
    - Meta: the metadata row
      - Duration
      - Certified
      - Completed

Preset props (`CardVerticalProps`):
| Prop | Concept | Kind | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `thumbnailSrc` | Image | content | `string` | none |
| `thumbnailAlt` | Image | content | `string` | `''` |
| `title` | Content | content | `string` | required |
| `duration` | Content | content | `string` | none |
| `certified` | Boolean | content | `boolean` | `false` |
| `progress` | Lifecycle | lifecycle | `number` (0–100) | none (omitted = not started) |
| `size` | Size | variant axis | `'sm' \| 'lg'` | `'lg'` |
| `action` | new term: the overlay slot | content | `ReactElement<CardVerticalFavoriteProps> \| ReactElement<CardVerticalMenuProps>` | none |

Part props:
| Part.prop | Concept | Kind | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Root.size` | Size | variant axis | `'sm' \| 'lg'` | `'lg'` |
| `Root.children` | Content | content | `ReactNode` | none |
| `Media.src` | Image | content | `string` | none |
| `Media.alt` | Image | content | `string` | `''` |
| `Media.children` | Content | content | `ReactElement<CardVerticalActionProps>` | none |
| `Action.children` | Content | content | `ReactElement<CardVerticalFavoriteProps> \| ReactElement<CardVerticalMenuProps>` | required |
| `Favorite.pressed` | Controlled state | controlled state | `boolean` | none |
| `Favorite.defaultPressed` | Controlled state | controlled state | `boolean` | `false` |
| `Favorite.onPressedChange` | Controlled state | controlled state | `(pressed: boolean) => void` | none |
| `Menu.items` | Collection | content | `DropdownMenuItem[]` | required |
| `Menu.onSelect` | Discrete event | event | `(value: string) => void` | required |
| `Progress.value` | new term: the progress bar's value, passed through | lifecycle | `number` (0–100) | required |
| `Body.children` | Content | content | `ReactNode` | required |
| `Title.as` | Element | element | `HeadingTag` | `'h3'` |
| `Title.children` | Content | content | `ReactNode` | required |
| `Meta.children` | Content | content | `ReactNode` | required |
| `Duration.children` | Content | content | `ReactNode` | required |

`Certified` and `Completed` take no props. All visible strings must render with the system's typography treatment. Style with a co-located CSS module (CardVertical/CardVertical.module.css) referencing only design-token custom properties. Also produce CardVertical/CardVertical.metadata.json that validates against the provided component.schema.json, and a behavioral a11y test CardVertical/CardVertical.a11y.test.tsx (Vitest + Testing Library + vitest-axe, axe's color-contrast rule disabled).

requiredPatterns.reason: the approved preset props type name
the approved part props type name
visible strings must render through the Text component
the title must render through the Heading component

forbiddenPatterns.reason: renames or adds a concept the approved API names (pressed/onPressedChange, certified, progress-derived status)
